recommendation_summary: The reply recommends a shared booking service as the only place agents can confirm reservations. A database rule would atomically reject overlapping dates for the same item, so when two agents submit together, one succeeds and the other gets a conflict message. For this week it adds the colours as a warning and sends every confirmation through one designated booking agent. It says plainly that this stopgap does not give the automatic rejection the owner requires, so that need stays unmet until the enforced save path is ready.
note: The reply chooses an atomic, server-enforced conflict rule that handles simultaneous submissions, but none of the four required record labels appear.
